title: Per-character Weil energy SUFFICES; missing input is a single Stepanov point-count on the subgroup-restricted curve
wall: W-BGK / W-Paley (worst-case incomplete subgroup character sum M(n)=max_{b!=0}|eta_b|, eta_b=sum_{x in mu_n} psi(b x) = generalized-Paley non-principal eigenvalue / Paley Graph Conjecture). The per-character object T_psi=e_a over a-subsets of mu_n is NOT Johnson-level/Stepanov-tractable; its worst case IS this wall, with NO sqrt(q) saving.
evidence: Exact probes scripts/probes/_407_conn/C097_perchar_stepanov.py and C097_saving_needed.py, PRIZE REGIME ONLY (thin dyadic mu_n PROPER subgroup of F_q*, q prime =1 mod n, q~n^beta beta in [4,5], (q-1)/n>1, n<<sqrt(q); n=8 q in {4129,4153}, n=16 q in {65537,65617}; order-n generator verified pow(h,n,q)=1 & exact order). THREE legs graded. (LEG 1 PROVEN-correct, conceded) The Plancherel bridge collision_le_of_relative_bound (MomentCollisionWeilConditional.lean, axiom-clean) IS a genuine reduction: M2*|A| <= C(n,a)^2 + (|A|-1)*B given per-character B, and M2 <= C^2/|A| + eps*C^2 given ||T_psi||^2 <= eps*C^2 for all psi!=0. That arithmetic is real and in tree; the per-character target is the right shape. (LEG 2 REFUTED, the load-bearing claim 'Stepanov delivers / SUFFICES') Two independent exact refutations. (2a QUANTITATIVE) The bridge needs eps small for ALL psi!=0; measured worst-case eps = max_{psi!=0} ||T_psi||^2 / C(n,a)^2 = 0.99/0.99 (n=8,a=2/4), 0.93/0.85 (n=16,a=2/8) -- near 1, NOT small. Equivalently the per-character SAVING S = C(n,a)^2/max||T_psi||^2 = 1.008..1.011 (n=8), 1.075..1.187 (n=16): essentially NO cancellation, while a sqrt(q)-strength Weil/Stepanov bound (the connection's own 'sqrt(q)-strength degree accounting') would need S ~ q = 4129..65617. The truth has S~1, q-fold short. The WORST psi is b=(0,b2), the PURE QUADRATIC-MOMENT character chi(x)=psi(b2 x^2): on the thin subgroup x^2 takes only n/2 distinct values (4 of 8 at n=8, 8 of 16 at n=16), so chi is near-constant on cosets and e_a barely cancels -- exactly the BGK/Paley collapse, NOT a Johnson-level quantity. (2b STRUCTURAL) T_psi = e_a(chi(x)), the degree-a elementary symmetric polynomial over a-element SUBSETS of mu_n (confirmed exactly: |e_2-(p1^2-p2)/2|=3e-16 via Newton). Stepanov's in-tree weil_stepanov_card_lt (StepanovWeilEngine.lean) bounds |V|*M for a UNIVARIATE point set V subset F (cardinality of a curve's F_q-rational points). There is NO instantiation (g,A0,A1,V,M) making the natural-number bound |V|*M < D equal to the complex-magnitude bound ||T_psi||^2 <= eps*C^2 -- categorically different objects (curve point count vs subset-elementary-symmetric character magnitude). The claimed glue lemma perChar_weil_bound_of_stepanov_aux does NOT exist in tree (only proposed in RESEARCH_SYNTHESIS_407_CONNECTIONS.md). In-tree no-gos agree: StepanovPointCountEngine is 'inapplicable to the joint count' (DISPROOF_LOG: t=2 count is over (k+2)-subsets, no univariate Psi has them as roots), and SubgroupCharacterSumNoGo.weil_recovers_root_count_not_better PROVES the character/Weil expansion recovers exactly the root count = k-1, 'Weil gives nothing past Johnson'. (LEG 3 OPEN/weld) The per-character worst case is M(n)=max_{b!=0}|eta_b| (BGK/Paley); the connection does not move it.
honest_note: REFUTED, with the GENUINE part of the insight conceded. Correct (and worth keeping): the per-character bound ||T_psi||^2 <= eps*C^2 IS the right reduction target for the M2 face, and the Plancherel bridge that establishes 'per-character suffices' is real and axiom-clean -- the F18 'per-psi not sup-over-family' framing is a legitimate observation. What is FALSE is the operative claim that this per-character bound is a Johnson-level Stepanov point-count that the assembled engine can deliver, thereby 'closing the M2/Johnson-side face unconditionally'. Refuted on BOTH axes by exact prize-regime probes: (i) quantitatively the worst-psi saving is ~1, not ~q -- there is NO sqrt(q) cancellation in T_psi=e_a on the thin subgroup, so the per-character bound the bridge needs is numerically FALSE (eps~0.85..0.99); (ii) structurally T_psi is a subset elementary-symmetric e_a, not the F_q-rational point count of any single univariate curve, so weil_stepanov_card_lt's |V|*M<D cannot be wired to hB (the proposed glue lemma does not exist, and two in-tree no-gos confirm Weil/Stepanov here reproduces only the root count = Johnson). The whole thing welds back to W-BGK/W-Paley: the worst character is the pure quadratic-moment one, whose flatness is exactly max_{b!=0}|eta_b| over thin dyadic mu_n = the 25-year-open Paley-Graph/BGK sqrt-cancellation problem. Consistent with sibling verdicts C079/C091 (same Plancherel machinery; L^2 mass free, L-inf worst frequency = the open core). What was NOT shown: I did not exhaust ALL psi at every prime (swept the two coordinate lines fully b<800 plus 800 random off-line psi); but the worst psi is structurally pinned to the b1=0 quadratic line and the measured near-1 ratio is robust across n=8/16 and both primes per n, and matches the BGK prediction. Recommend DISPROOF_LOG one-liner: 'C097: Plancherel per-character reduction (||T_psi||^2<=eps*C^2 => M2 anti-conc) is real, but T_psi=e_a over a-subsets of mu_n has worst-case saving S=C^2/max||T||^2 ~ 1 (NOT ~q) at prize primes 4129/65537 -- NO sqrt(q) cancellation; worst psi=(0,b2) pure-quadratic = BGK/Paley collapse (x^2 hits only n/2 values on mu_n). Stepanov's |V|*M<D (univariate curve point count) cannot wire to hB (subset elementary-symmetric magnitude); glue lemma perChar_weil_bound_of_stepanov_aux nonexistent; SubgroupCharacterSumNoGo.weil_recovers_root_count_not_better already proves Weil=root count=Johnson. Welds to W-BGK.'
